name: Pinball Arcade: Judge Dredd
storyline: Judge Dredd (1993) was designed by John Trudeau, and was part of Williams / Midway's SuperPin line of wide body games. Based on the comic series 2000 AD, players take on the role of the most respected and feared lawman in Mega-City One, Judge Dredd. Their challenge is to patrol the streets while apprehending criminals and defending justice. The playfield is loaded with features including the rotating Deadworld planet, triple-deck wire-form ramps and a magnetic robotic arm that picks up the ball. This is the only SuperPin to feature Super games, which are four additional Multi-Ball games that can be played with an additional credit. 6,990 units of this table were produced.
